Hyodol (combine Korean word "Hyo," meaning filial piety and love for parents with the English word "Doll") is an AI-powered robot with 7 year old grandchild character and appearance. It has a unique purpose: monitor and assist elderly individuals to maintain their physical and mental well-being through communication technology. Check out more information: https://en.hyodol.com/

Hyodol (combine Korean word "Hyo," meaning filial piety and love for parents with the English word "Doll") is an AI-powered robot with 7 year old grandchild character and appearance. It has a unique purpose: monitor and assist elderly individuals to maintain their physical and mental well-being through communication technology. Check out more information: https://en.hyodol.com/

효돌(부모에 대한 효심과 사랑을 뜻하는 우리말 '효'와 영어 단어 '인형'의 합성어)은 7살 손자의 성격과 외모를 가진 인공지능 돌봄 로봇입니다. ICT 기술을 통해 어르신의 신체적, 정신적 건강을 모니터링하고 보조하는 독특한 목적을 가지고 있습니다. 자세한 정보를 확인해 보세요: https://www.hyodol.com/
